column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV supplies “good” before “name,” and renders “good favor” “Loving favor.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they meet together” is rendered “have this in common.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the consequence of humility, the fear of the LORD” is rendered “By humility and the fear of the LORD.”
Close to the Hebrew; “according to the mouth of his way” is rendered “in the way he should go.”
Close to the Hebrew; יִכְלֶה (“will come to an end”) is rendered “will fail.”
Close to the Hebrew; “good of eye” is rendered “a generous eye.”
Close to the Hebrew; the plural “strange women” is rendered “an immoral woman,” and “cursed” “abhorred.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in your belly” is rendered “within you.”
NKJV follows the traditional reading, “excellent things,” for the written שָׁלִישִׁים (“thirty [sayings] / officers”).
Close to the Hebrew; “to those who sent you” is rendered “To those who send to you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a master of anger” is rendered “an angry man.”
Close to the Hebrew; חֲשֻׁכִּים (“obscure men”) is rendered “unknown men.”
